population: All certified-estimated neutral per-order actions, strict timing subset separately; exclusions recorded
model: Saved full v2 LGBM p and v heads fixed, exact parity required
calibration: Reserved earlier day only, all actions including no fills, no tail trimming
score_setups: side x queue x edge residual
side x queue x edge x pressure residual
exposure_scale: P(fill) x client-known remaining; normalization for calibration, not forecast actual fill quantity
pressure_bins: joint adverse 250ms OFI (Predict and Binance depth): persistent also at 1000ms, transient, other, unknown/stale; stale = either age >250ms
controls: Saved head parity; calibration chronology; planted opposite-state residual; changed future outcomes do not change application; invalid probabilities/remaining/no-fill labels refused; matched oracle
economic_comparators: Same kept counts by day/hour/side/rung/exact known remaining; raw ranking, order-only calibration ranking and exact analytic random expectation; all gains/losses retained
replay_screen: Pressure correction margin 0.1: delta vs raw >0 and vs order-only at equal counts >0 pooled and >=4/5 days; kept value >0 pooled and >=4/5. Failure -> no replay warranted by local screen. Success -> separately declare sequential replay, not policy promotion.
scope: Local per-order loss diagnosis and economic-layer screen; no portfolio/uptime/churn claim without sequential replay
